page_title: CLCOR 350-801 — How Much Do I Know?
meta_description: Free chapter-by-chapter practice tests for the CCNP & CCIE Collaboration Core (CLCOR 350-801) exam. Works online, offline, and as an installable app.
eyebrow: Cisco Press · Official Cert Guide, 2nd Ed.
study_guide_link_text: CCNP and CCIE Collaboration Core CLCOR 350-801 Official Cert Guide, 2nd Edition — read on O'Reilly Learning
prep_sites_html:
• OpenExamPrep: free, independent 350-801 study guide (not affiliated with Cisco).
  • Cisco Press: official CLCOR chapter excerpts, including the globalized call routing chapter's own quiz on the NANP wildcard.
  • CBT Nuggets, learncisco.net, Global Knowledge: Cisco training providers.
  • Braindump sites (such as ExamTopics) were not used. They post leaked live-exam questions, which breaks Cisco's exam agreement, and their community answers are often wrong.
